import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_84/test_0.csv"
]

# List to hold transformed DataFrames
transformed_dfs = []

# Process each source file
for file_path in source_files:
    # Load source data
    df_source = pd.read_csv(file_path)
    
    # Transform: Extract V_GENE from V_CALL by removing everything after '*'
    # Example: "IGHV1-8*01" -> "IGHV1-8"
    df_source['V_GENE'] = df_source['V_CALL'].str.split('*').str[0]
    
    # Select only the target schema column
    df_target = df_source[['V_GENE']]
    
    # Append to list
    transformed_dfs.append(df_target)

# Concatenate all transformed DataFrames (if multiple sources)
df_final = pd.concat(transformed_dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Optional: If you want unique V_GENE values only (not specified, but often useful)
# df_final = df_final.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)

# Write the final DataFrame to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_84/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_final.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
